description: Ministry of Lands - The Industrial Dispute between South Asia Gateway Terminals (Pvt.) Ltd. Vs. Inter Company Employees Union (E Only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a private company and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains legal/regulatory content as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes employment terms, wage structures, and dispute resolution mechanisms. The document is published by the Commissioner General of Labour in accordance with statutory authority, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
